newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Port. Telecom sets Monday news conference.
newsitem.headline: Port. Telecom sets Monday news conference.

text.p: Portuguese Planning Minister Joao Cravinho and the board of state-controlled Portugal Telecom, which comes under his ministry, will give a joint news conference on Monday at 0800 GMT, the company said in a statement.

It gave no further details but market sources said that the press conference could be connected with an expected announcement shortly about which international telecommications alliance the company had opted to join.
It had long said an announcement should be made around the middle of April.

Analysts say that the Anglo-American alliance Consort, headed by British Telecom and MCI is in pole position, but the choice could still fall on the AT&T-led Unisource or the U.S.-German-French group Global One.
